name: Pattern
tagline: Agentic content strategist for short-form creators
maker_comment_excerpt: Hey Product Hunt! Stephen here, solo founder of Pattern and a content creator myself. We first launched here in May. Since then 300+ creators have signed up, and their feedback changed the product a lot, and I'm excited to share the new version with you! What's new: • Draft review: upload your video before you post and see what to fix while you still can • Competitor analysis: paste any viral video link from your niche and Pattern breaks down why it worked, then turns it into ideas that fit your
